name: Solar Flare
description: A burst of solar particles temporarily raises radiation exposure.

name: Instrument Glitch
description: An instrument briefly needs a reset and misses a few observations.

name: Communications Dropout
description: A scheduled contact is lost and the recorder has to wait for another pass.

name: Micrometeoroid Impact
description: A tiny impact causes a temporary spacecraft subsystem fault.

name: Bonus Extended Mission
description: The spacecraft remains healthy long enough to collect extra observations.

name: Operations Budget Cut
description: Ground operations are reduced, limiting instrument time and contacts.
